mapper.insert: INSERT INTO db_conn (conn_name, host, app_name, db_url, username, password, is_default) VALUES (#{connName}, #{host}, #{appName}, #{dbUrl}, #{username}, #{password}, #{isDefault})
mapper.sql: id, conn_name, host, app_name, db_url, username, is_default, create_time, CASE WHEN COALESCE(password, '') <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_password
mapper.select: SELECT FROM db_conn ORDER BY is_default DESC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT , FROM db_conn WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT , FROM db_conn ORDER BY is_default DESC, id ASC LIMIT 10
mapper.update: UPDATE db_conn SET is_default = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
